mono-20101.d: Domes stack on domes and four minarets rise over a jumble of old rooftops. Three small figures cross the square, unbothered by the view.
mono-20101.t: A great domed mosque with four slender pencil minarets, seen from above over a crowded old town of tiled roofs and a paved square, the city running back to low hills

mono-20102.d: A gramophone raises its fluted horn over a stepped wooden cabinet. It plays one record at a time and has never once asked to be updated.
mono-20102.t: An antique wind-up gramophone in three-quarter view: a stepped wooden cabinet on four feet, the turntable and sound box on top, and a great fluted horn flaring up and out

mono-20103.d: A bristling crab from above, two great claws raised over its back and eight jointed walking legs, with an outline of its shell and two detail sketches. It is holding both claws up, which is either a greeting or a warning.
mono-20103.t: A spiny crab seen from above with its claws raised, its shell drawn in outline above and two detail sketches below

mono-20104.d: A four-door touring car of the twenties in exact side view, spoked wheels, folding hood, long bonnet and running board. It has not needed a service since about 1931.
mono-20104.t: A 1920s touring car with its hood up, in plain side elevation on a thin ground line

mono-20105.d: Steep slate mansards, dormer windows, iron balconies and forests of chimney pots climbing towards a single spire. Everyone up there has a view and nobody has a lift.
mono-20105.t: A crowd of old town houses with mansard roofs, dormers and chimney pots under one spire, seen from a high window

mono-20106.d: A brass compound microscope with its coarse and fine focus, two stages and a heavy foot, ringed by sketches of its eyepieces and fittings. Wear it to look closely at things.
mono-20106.t: An antique compound microscope large in the centre, with its eyepieces, objectives and fittings drawn small around it

mono-20107.d: A long ocean fish cuts down through the water with its sail of a fin raised and every scale drawn in. It looks entirely certain of where it is going, which puts it ahead of most of us.
mono-20107.t: A single ocean fish swimming at a slant, with a tall ribbed sail of a dorsal fin, a deep forked tail and fine net-like scales

mono-20108.d: A banded steel sphere hangs in elevation, its one round porthole set in the middle band and a ladder climbing its curve. Whoever drew it left out what it is for, which is either modesty or a secret.
mono-20108.t: A riveted steel sphere in elevation, banded round its middle, with a round porthole, a ladder up its side and fittings on top and below

mono-20109.d: A terrace of brownstones climbs five storeys above a run of stone stoops, every window capped with its own carved hood. Each stoop seats two neighbours comfortably and an opinion about parking indefinitely.
mono-20109.t: A row of old brownstone town houses seen at an angle, with stone stoops, iron railings, balconies, carved window heads and a street tree

mono-20110.d: A single spiral shell unrolls from a tight coil into a broad ribbed sweep, its keel picked out in small knobs. Whoever lived in it has moved somewhere with more cupboard space.
mono-20110.t: One large thin-walled spiral seashell seen from the side, a tight coil at its centre opening into a wide flaring whorl, fine radiating ribs and a row of small knobs along the keel

mono-20111.d: An old refracting telescope stands on its tall tripod, tilted at the sky with its finder scope ready. It has been pointed upwards for so long it has forgotten what the ground looks like.
mono-20111.t: One antique refracting telescope with a finder scope, eyepiece and dew cap, on an altazimuth head and a three-legged tripod, standing on a ruled floor with its shadow

mono-20112.d: Old tenements climb over a narrow market lane, each storey jutting a little further out than the last. The top floors are close enough to pass a teapot across.
mono-20112.t: Old wooden-framed tenement blocks stacked storey on storey along a narrow lane, deep eaves with upturned tips, balconies and many-paned windows, rows of market stalls with covered roofs down the street below

mono-20113.d: A single saxophone stands upright in white line, every key and rod along its body drawn in place. It is the quietest one has ever been.
mono-20113.t: One saxophone seen from the side, the crook and mouthpiece at the top, the long body lined with round key pads, rods and guards, the curved bow and the upturned flared bell

mono-20114.d: A chameleon grips a branch with split feet, one turret eye on the watch and its casque raised. It is very good at blending in, which is more than can be said for the shirt.
mono-20114.t: A single chameleon gripping a branch, side on, with its helmet-like casque, turret eye and curled tail

mono-20115.d: A tall rocket stands on its landing feet, boosters strapped to its sides and fins swept back. It has been ready for launch for some time now and is in no hurry.
mono-20115.t: A single space rocket in side elevation, with nose cone, strap-on boosters, swept fins and landing feet on a thin ground line

mono-20116.d: A cobbled street curves between tall old houses towards a gate, with a church tower keeping watch above the roofs. The cobbles have outlasted every shoe that walked on them, and will see off yours as well.
mono-20116.t: A narrow cobbled street between tall old houses, a tiered church tower and a thin spire rising behind, in fine pen hatching

mono-20117.d: A lever espresso machine stands square on, gauges up, portafilter locked in and its long lever ready to pull. It is quite capable of making one very good coffee before anyone has properly woken up.
mono-20117.t: A single lever espresso machine seen from the front, with gauges, bean hopper, group head, portafilter and a long side lever, drawn in white line on black

mono-20118.d: One large hummingbird hangs in the air with its wings spread and bill raised, while two smaller ones hover at its sides. They beat their wings dozens of times a second and still find the time to look composed.
mono-20118.t: A hummingbird hovering with its wings raised and long bill pointed up, two smaller hummingbirds in flight either side

mono-20119.d: An old twin-cylinder motorcycle stands in clean side view on a single ruled line, every spoke, fin and pipe accounted for. It has a luggage rack and a seat for one, which settles the question of who carries the shopping.
mono-20119.t: A single vintage motorcycle in side elevation, spoked wheels, teardrop tank, sprung saddle, rear rack and a V-twin engine, on a thin ground line

mono-20120.d: Tall old houses lean over a cobbled lane of arcades and balconies, with a spire closing the view and fruit sellers at work below. The street was laid out long before anyone thought of parking.
mono-20120.t: A narrow old street of tall stone houses with arcades, balconies and hanging plants, a church spire at the far end, fruit carts and baskets on the cobbles

mono-20121.d: An old studio microphone stands on its stem and heavy round foot, its ribbed grille drawn bar by bar. It has heard a great many people clear their throats.
mono-20121.t: A single vintage studio microphone with a ribbed grille on a jointed mount, a short stem and a round weighted base

mono-20122.d: A big horned beetle sprawls across the middle of a collector's sheet, its smaller relatives lined up round the edges. Nobody asked the small ones whether they minded the seating plan.
mono-20122.t: A large horned beetle seen from above, six legs spread, with a sheet of smaller beetles and bugs drawn round it

mono-20123.d: A small steamer sits on a flat calm, one funnel, one mast and a web of rigging pulled taut fore and aft. It has clearly never been asked to hurry.
mono-20123.t: A small steam vessel in side elevation, funnel, wheelhouse and one mast with its rigging, on a thin waterline

mono-20124.d: A narrow cobbled lane climbs between tall stone houses towards a spired building at the top of the hill. Every step up is one fewer you will have to walk back down.
mono-20124.t: A steep cobbled lane climbing between tall stone houses to a spired building at the top

mono-20125.d: An old library globe sits in its horizon ring on a turned pedestal, continents and grid lines drawn across the sphere. It has spent a long career pointing at places it will never visit.
mono-20125.t: An antique terrestrial globe on a turned pedestal stand, with its horizon ring and meridian ring, continents and grid lines

mono-20126.d: A tree frog sits square on a leaf and looks straight back, round eyes wide and toe pads spread for grip. It has the air of someone who has been waiting for you for some time.
mono-20126.t: A single big-eyed tree frog sitting face on, on a broad veined leaf, its toe pads splayed

mono-20127.d: A Ferris wheel stands face on, its spokes running in to one hub and its cabins hung round the rim. It goes nowhere at great expense and everyone queues for it anyway.
mono-20127.t: A single Ferris wheel seen face on, its spokes, rim and hanging cabins on an A-frame over a small station and a ground line

mono-20128.d: A tennis racket stands at the centre of a patent sheet, its strings and wrapped grip drawn out with a column of parts on either side. None of it will help your backhand, but it does look the part.
mono-20128.t: A single tennis racket upright in the centre, strung head, open throat and wrapped grip, with small detail drawings of parts in two columns round it

mono-20129.d: A snake lies coiled in thick, finely scaled loops with its head lifted to look over its own body. It has no legs, no arms and no apparent worries.
mono-20129.t: A single snake coiled in heavy loops, its head raised and turned to one side, every scale drawn

mono-20130.d: A stone observatory rises in three ringed storeys to a ribbed dome with its observing slit opened to the sky. The building does its best work at night and keeps its curtains open on purpose.
mono-20130.t: A domed observatory on a round, three-storey stone drum, the shutter slit of the dome open along one rib, steps at its foot

mono-20131.d: A baroque church front fills the end of a narrow street, its domed towers rising over a rose window and an arched door. The houses either side have been leaning in for a better look for a few hundred years.
mono-20131.t: A baroque church front with two onion-domed towers and a third domed tower, a rose window over the arched door, old houses lining the street on either side and a paved square in front

mono-20132.d: An old rotary telephone stands tall on its square base, the finger dial below and the handset resting on a cradle above, a spare earpiece and fittings drawn alongside. It takes a full second per digit and has never once sent anyone a notification.
mono-20132.t: A vintage rotary telephone with a finger dial in its square base, a tall column carrying a cradled handset, coiled cords and a few detached parts beside it

mono-20133.d: A raven sits on a weathered stump, every wing feather laid down in close pen hatching. It has the look of a bird that has already decided what it thinks of you.
mono-20133.t: A single raven perched on an old broken stump, seen side on, its heavy beak, glossy head and layered wing feathers drawn in fine engraved hatching

mono-20134.d: Three stone arches carry a balustraded road between two round towers over a quiet river. Whoever built the towers was clearly expecting more trouble than the river has ever given.
mono-20134.t: An old stone bridge of three round arches seen from the side, a balustraded parapet between two round towers, trees and boulders on both banks and still water beneath

mono-20135.d: Old stone and timber houses lean over a narrow canal where small wooden boats wait at their moorings. Nobody here has needed to look for a parking space in several centuries.
mono-20135.t: A narrow canal running between tall old houses with balconies, shutters and tiled roofs, wooden rowing boats moored along the water and a hill town climbing behind

mono-20136.d: A hiking boot is drawn twice, once from the side down to every lug of its sole and once from above with the laces criss-crossing. The plans are thorough; the blisters are not included.
mono-20136.t: A leather lace-up hiking boot seen from the side with its eyelets, padded cuff and deep lugged sole, beside the same boot seen from above with its laces crossing the tongue

mono-20137.d: A fox sits upright with its brush wrapped round its paws, every hair of its coat drawn in fine pen. It is looking at something just out of frame and has clearly already made up its mind about it.
mono-20137.t: A fox sitting upright, three-quarter side view, ears up and brush curled round its feet

mono-20138.d: A mid-century farm tractor drawn in clean side view, from its slatted grille to its deep-treaded rear tyre. It has one speed, which is slower than the car behind it.
mono-20138.t: An old farm tractor in side elevation: big ribbed rear wheel, small spoked front wheel, bonnet, grille, exhaust stack and steering wheel

mono-20139.d: A stone bridge arches over a narrow river, hemmed in by leaning timber-framed houses and their chimneys. The houses have stood there for centuries, mostly by leaning on each other.
mono-20139.t: A stone arch bridge over a narrow river between tall timber-framed medieval houses, gables, chimneys and a little tower

mono-20140.d: A hand-tied fishing fly, all feather wings and fine legs, with the hook curled discreetly underneath. It is built to look exactly like dinner, which is the whole point.
mono-20140.t: An artificial fishing fly seen from the side: a bulbous head, a ribbed body, feather wings and tail, thin legs and a curved hook beneath

mono-20141.d: A tall spotted mushroom stands over five smaller relations, every gill drawn under its broad cap. Nobody has yet decided which of them is safe to eat, and nobody is volunteering.
mono-20141.t: One large spotted mushroom with gills under its cap, five smaller mushrooms round it on a tuft of grass and twigs

mono-20142.d: A steel lattice tower rises from a strip of scrub, its girders crossing all the way up to a slim spire. It has stood there a long time without receiving a single compliment.
mono-20142.t: One tall steel lattice tower seen side on, two cross-arms near the top, guy wires running to the ground, low bushes at its feet

mono-20143.d: Stone steps climb between twisted pines to the door of a three-roofed temple, every tile and needle drawn. The view at the top is said to be worth it, which is what people say about all stairs.
mono-20143.t: A long flight of stone steps with balustrades climbing between pine trees and shrubs to a temple with three curved tiled roofs

mono-20144.d: A diamond kite spreads its crossed spars in the middle of a patent sheet, bridle lines and tail drawn with care. The drawing assumes a steady breeze, which is the most optimistic thing about it.
mono-20144.t: One diamond kite with crossed spars, bridle lines and a knotted tail string, four round detail drawings in the corners
